items.title: GitHub release: anthropics/claude-code v2.1.317
items.what_happened: ## What's changed - Added a warning to `/schedule` when a new cloud scheduled task gets connectors you did not ask for, with how to remove them - Added a check that asks before a web or shell tool call sends your account email address to the network - Added `onFailure: "block"` for Agent SDK hook callbacks, so a callback that fails blocks the action instead of letting it run - Added a notice in Claude Desktop's Code

items.title: Ukraine’s new pocket-sized gadget turns Russian drones’ cameras against them
items.what_happened: A Kyiv startup’s pocket-sized, 10-ounce receiver lets Ukrainian troops watch the video feeds of Russian drones, though Russian moves toward digital video and AI-guided drones that emit no signals could make the victory short-lived.

items.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
items.what_happened: Y Combinator Garry Tan has jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, Tan put a price tag on his passion.
